column1: Three Bees Burnt Ivory Timer Taper 6"
column4:
Our 6" tall Three Bees Burnt Ivory Timer Taper has a rustic, textured wax coating with a flame-shaped tip. There is a row of black, bees printed on one side.
Directions: This is a timer candle, which means it lights for 6 hours straight, then automatically shuts off for 18, and then repeats the process. Simply twist the bottom of the candle to light. To change time sequence, just turn off and turn back on at desired time.
Requires 2 AA batteries (not included).
